$comment: Catalogue entries this pipeline provides, to be ingested into the Agora catalogue. Provenance and license are pending: see the README.

entity_types.description: Area served by a postal code. Postal codes are sets of addresses with no official boundary; these areas are an approximation.

key.name: postal_code
key.description: Five digits; the first two are the province's INE code.

relation_types.description: The province given by the code's first two digits. Postal codes don't nest in municipalities.

description.es: Áreas aproximadas de los códigos postales en enero de 2024. Sirven para situar en el mapa datos que solo vienen con código postal. Correos no publica límites oficiales: son una aproximación, y los códigos creados o cambiados después no están.
description.en: Approximate areas of postal codes in January 2024. They place on the map data that only comes with a postal code. Correos doesn't publish official boundaries: they're an approximation, and codes created or changed since aren't included.

processing.es: Importadas de un proyecto anterior; su fuente original y su licencia están pendientes de documentar, por eso no se pueden descargar.
processing.en: Imported from an earlier project; their original source and license are still to be documented, so they can't be downloaded.
